notes: The seed repertoire: the map round's juice as works, plus four to start from (docs/artist-agent.md).

works.title: The ledger
works.about: The check as it was first made: a white stamp, sparks and gold, a hard shake.

works.title: Lamplight
works.about: The room is lit in the colour of the decision you just made.

works.title: The heavy hand
works.about: Bigger, slower, harder: a longer freeze and a deeper shake.

works.title: Night watch
works.about: Late at night, stars come out over the map.

works.title: Wax seal
works.about: Rarely, the check is a wax seal pressed with the date.
